description: This file defines autograd functional utilities for computing derivatives such as Jacobian, Hessian, vector-Jacobian products, and vector-Hessian products in PyTorch. It includes utility functions for handling tuples of tensors, gradient computations, and the main API functions like vjp, jvp, jacobian, hessian, vhp, and hvp.

methods.name: _as_tuple_nocheck
methods.description: Converts input to a tuple if it is a list or tuple; otherwise wraps it in a tuple.

methods.name: _as_tuple
methods.description: Ensures input is a tuple of tensors, raises error if elements are not tensors.

methods.name: _tuple_postprocess
methods.description: Unpacks nested tuples of tensors based on a boolean flag to match original input structure.

methods.name: _grad_preprocess
methods.description: Prepares tensors for gradient computation, creating copies or detaching as needed.

methods.name: _grad_postprocess
methods.description: Detaches tensors if create_graph is False, to avoid history.

methods.name: _validate_v
methods.description: Validates that vector v matches the shape of the output tensors.

methods.name: _check_requires_grad
methods.description: Checks if tensors require gradients, raises errors in strict mode if conditions are not met.

methods.name: _autograd_grad
methods.description: Wrapper around torch.autograd.grad that handles None outputs and grad_outputs.

methods.name: _fill_in_zeros
methods.description: Replaces None gradients with zeros or raises errors in strict mode.

methods.name: vjp
methods.description: Computes vector-Jacobian product for a function at given inputs.

methods.name: jvp
methods.description: Computes Jacobian-vector product for a function at given inputs.

methods.name: _construct_standard_basis_for
methods.description: Constructs a standard basis (identity matrix) split into chunks matching tensor sizes.

methods.name: _jacfwd
methods.description: Computes Jacobian using forward-mode AD with optional vectorization.

methods.name: jacobian
methods.description: Computes the Jacobian matrix of a function at given inputs, supports reverse and forward mode.

methods.name: hessian
methods.description: Computes the Hessian matrix of a scalar function at given inputs.

methods.name: vhp
methods.description: Computes vector-Hessian product for a scalar function at given inputs.

methods.name: hvp
methods.description: Computes Hessian-vector product for a scalar function at given inputs.
